normalized_effect:
[A] When this becomes Reversed in battle, look at up to 3 cards from the
top of your Library and search for up to 1 Climax card, reveal it, put it in
your hand, and put the rest in the Waiting Room. If you put a card in your hand
this way, discard a card from your hand to the Waiting Room.
[C] If there are 3 or fewer cards in your Stock, this gains +2000 Power.

[A] When this is placed from hand to the Stage, look at up to 3 cards
from the top of your Library and search for up to 1 Event, reveal it, put it in
your hand, and put the rest in the Waiting Room. If you put a card in your hand
this way, discard a card from your hand to the Waiting Room.
[A] When this is placed from hand to the Stage, if there is 1 or fewer
Character in your Opponent's Front Row, you may choose a Cost 0 or lower
Character in your Opponent's Front Row and put it in the Waiting Room.

[C] All your other [CHARACTER] gain +1000 Power and +1
Soul.
[A] BOND/[CHARACTER] [Discard a card from your hand to the
Waiting Room]

[C] ASSIST All your Characters in front of this gain +500 Power.
[S] [(1) Discard a Climax card from your hand to the Waiting Room] Choose a
Character in your Waiting Room and return it to your hand.

[A] When your COLOR Climax card is placed in the Climax Zone, choose 1
of your Characters, and that Character gains +1500 Power for the turn.
[S] BRAINSTORM [(1) Rest this] Flip over the top 5 cards of your Library and
put them in the Waiting Room. For each Climax card revealed this way, draw up
to 1 card.

[A] When this is placed from hand to the Stage, this gains +X Power for
the turn. X = 500 times # of your ::TRAIT:: Characters.
[A] CX COMBO When this attacks, if [CHARACTER] is in the Climax
Zone and you have another ::TRAIT:: Character, look at up to 4 cards from top
of your Library and search for up to 1 ::TRAIT:: Character, reveal it, put it
in your hand, and put the rest in the Waiting Room.

[A] When this attacks, choose 1 of your other ::TRAIT:: Characters, and
that Character gains +X Power for the turn. X = 1000 times Soul of that
Character.
[A] During battles involving this, when Damage taken by you is Cancelled, you
may return this to your hand.

[C] If you have 3 or more other Characters, this gains +2000 Power.
[A] ENCORE [Discard a Character card from your hand to the Waiting Room]

[A] When you use the BACKUP of this, reveal the top card of your Library.
If it's a ::TRAIT:: Character, put it in your hand and discard a card from your
hand to the Waiting Room. (Otherwise put it back where it was)
[S] [Counter] BACKUP 2000, Level 1 [(1) Discard this card from your hand to the
Waiting Room]
[C] ASSIST All your Characters in front of this gain +1000 Power.

[C] During your turn, for each of your other ::TRAIT:: Characters, this
gains +1500 Power.

[C] If you have 3 or more other Characters, this gains +3000 Power.
[A] ENCORE [Discard a ::TRAIT:: Character card from your hand to the Waiting
Room]

[A] [Discard a card from your hand to the Waiting Room] When this is
placed from hand to the Stage, you may pay cost. If so, choose up to 2
Characters in your Waiting Room and return them to your hand.

[A] When this is placed from hand to the Stage, you may put the top card
of your Clock in the Waiting Room.
[A] [(1)] When this attacks, you may pay cost. If so, choose a card in your
Opponent's Waiting Room and put it on top of their Library.
